purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 18-record item effect batch 019; together these files contain exactly 18 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/armor-fallen-leaves-1.name: Armor of the Fallen Leaves [Relic]
items/armor-fallen-leaves-1.effectSummary: For a neutral-good, lawful-neutral, neutral, chaotic-neutral, or neutral-evil wearer, the nonmetal armor functions as a +1 wild breastplate and does not violate a druid's spiritual oaths. With the relic connection to Obad-Hai, once per day the wearer can dissolve into controlled falling leaves for up to 30 minutes, moving and interacting as under gaseous form; the stronger qualification allows two uses per day.

items/beastfriend-collar.name: Beastfriend Collar
items/beastfriend-collar.effectSummary: The collar grants +4 competence on Handle Animal and wild empathy checks. If the wearer has an animal companion or familiar, the range of share spells becomes 5 feet per two character levels, and as an immediate action the wearer can exchange places with that companion or familiar while it is within share-spells range, subject to the item's reuse interval.

items/choker-of-the-sirens.name: Choker of the Sirens
items/choker-of-the-sirens.effectSummary: The wearer can breathe water continuously. A female wearer can also sing once per day to captivate creatures within 90 feet that fail Will DC 12 + her Charisma modifier; captivated creatures move toward her, become fascinated and helpless within 5 feet, and can make additional saves after taking damage or via countersong. Attaching a pearl of the sirens raises the save DC by 2.

items/cloak-of-mysterious-emergence.name: Cloak of Mysterious Emergence
items/cloak-of-mysterious-emergence.effectSummary: The cloak has three charges per day. Spending one charge as a standard action teleports the wearer up to 120 feet as dimension door, and the wearer can take no further actions until the next turn; spending all three charges instead teleports the wearer and up to 50 pounds of items up to 120 miles.

items/idol-of-apostasy.name: Idol of Apostasy
items/idol-of-apostasy.effectSummary: A good creature that views the idol must succeed on Will DC 19 or have its moral inhibitions suppressed and alignment immediately changed to its polar opposite until break enchantment ends the effect. A successful save protects that viewer from the same idol for 24 hours, after which viewing it again requires another save.

items/necklace-of-the-marauding-beast.name: Necklace of the Marauding Beast
items/necklace-of-the-marauding-beast.effectSummary: Three versions exist. Raging Bear grants +2 enhancement Strength; Frenzied Shark grants +2 enhancement Strength and +4 circumstance on Swim; Rampaging Boar grants Sunder, or Great Sunder if already possessed, plus +1 enhancement Constitution. Each version also extends the wearer's rage by 1 round.

items/nolzurs-orb.name: Nolzur's Orb
items/nolzurs-orb.effectSummary: The orb produces paints usable as Nolzur's marvelous pigments once per day. Its paints can also grant +10 competence on Disguise checks for up to 30 minutes while dry, and once per day can be flung as a prismatic spray with 60-foot range; if stored in another container, the paints lose these extra orb-specific properties.

items/platinum-helm-604.name: Platinum Helm [Relic]
items/platinum-helm-604.effectSummary: For a lawful-good, neutral-good, or lawful-neutral wearer, the helm grants immunity to the frightful presence of evil dragons. With the relic connection to Bahamut, three times per day an attack can trigger a 60-foot frightful presence effect using DC 10 + half the wearer's Hit Dice + Charisma modifier, panicking foes of 4 or fewer HD and shaking stronger foes for 4d6 rounds; the stronger qualification also grants blindsense 60 feet for 1 hour once per day.

items/rapier-desperate-measures-632.name: Rapier of Desperate Measures [Relic]
items/rapier-desperate-measures-632.effectSummary: For a chaotic-neutral, neutral, chaotic-good, or chaotic-evil wielder, the weapon functions as a +2 rapier. With the relic connection to Olidammara, it gains keen while the wielder is below full hit points and speed while the wielder is below half normal hit points.
